headline: Refined products slide as market shrugs off fresh Iran sanctions
intro: RBOB and ULSD futures gave back last week's multi-month highs even as Washington rolled out new pressure on Tehran — proof that the fuels complex is trading its own fundamentals more than headline risk right now.
overview: Diesel led the pullback, with ULSD futures down roughly 5% and around 11 cents on the day, while RBOB slipped 6-8 cents as crude eased on reassessed Middle East risk; retail gasoline nonetheless sits near $4.10-4.18/gal nationally, still elevated versus a month ago. On policy, EPA's delay of the biofuel compliance deadline hammered ethanol (RIN) credit prices to four-month lows, while Nigerian seaborne product exports — boosted by the Dangote refinery — continue reshaping global supply flows amid constrained output elsewhere. Overseas, a drone strike set Russia's Afipsky refinery ablaze and Kazakhstan's Atyrau refinery also caught fire, adding to the drumbeat of Russian refining disruptions that has underpinned distillate cracks.

stories.title: Energy Markets Pull Back After Multi-Month Highs
stories.summary: Refined products led energy-complex selling to start the week, with ULSD futures down around 11 cents and RBOB down 6-8 cents across September/October contracts, pulling back from multi-month highs; crude fell a more modest $1.25/bbl.

stories.title: Nymex Overview: Petroleum Futures Fall as Market Shrugs Off Latest Iran Sanctions — OPIS
stories.summary: ULSD futures fell 5% (September contract down 22.71 cents to $4.2677/gal) as the market shrugged off the latest Iran sanctions ahead of contract expiration.

stories.title: Nymex Overview: Petroleum Futures Falling Ahead of Announcement on U.S. Economic Action Against Iran — OPIS
stories.summary: Petroleum futures fell ahead of the U.S. announcement on economic action against Iran, with national average retail gasoline slipping slightly to $4.0991/gal to start the week.

stories.title: Oil futures fall as Middle East risks are reassessed
stories.summary: Oil futures fell as traders reassessed Middle East supply-disruption risk and political stability concerns tied to Iran tensions.

stories.title: Oil Retreats While Iran Pressure Builds
stories.summary: Crude prices declined even as traders weighed new US sanctions pressure on Tehran.

stories.title: Iran Running Out of Oil Cargoes
stories.summary: Iran's oil shipments to Asia have all but dried up, pushing remaining cargo costs to multi-year highs ahead of expected fresh U.S. isolation measures.

stories.title: Asian Refiners Scoop Up US Crude
stories.summary: Asian refiners are set to nearly double September purchases of U.S. crude versus a month earlier, a shift that could squeeze domestic fuel makers as U.S. pump prices sit at records.

stories.title: Dangote refinery drives increase in petroleum shipments from Nigeria
stories.summary: Seaborne petroleum product exports from Nigeria have grown seven-fold since 2023 as Dangote refinery output ramps up, filling gaps left by constrained supply elsewhere.

stories.title: US ethanol credit prices slump after EPA delays biofuel compliance deadline
stories.summary: U.S. ethanol blending credit (RIN) prices plunged to four-month lows after EPA delayed a biofuel compliance deadline.

stories.title: EIA Edges USA Demand Forecast Down for 2026, Up for 2027
stories.summary: EIA trimmed its 2026 U.S. total energy consumption forecast while nudging 2027 projections up.

stories.title: Drone Strike Sparks Fire at Oil Refinery in Southern Russia
stories.summary: An overnight drone strike sparked a fire at Russia's Afipsky oil refinery in the Krasnodar region, per the regional governor.

stories.title: An oil refinery is on fire in Kazakhstan
stories.summary: Kazakhstan's Atyrau oil refinery (ANPZ) is on fire, according to local reporting.

stories.title: Sinopec Says China Oil Demand 'Very Likely' Peaked in 2025
stories.summary: Sinopec's chief said China's oil demand likely peaked in 2025, earlier than previously estimated, as the top refiner faces overcapacity pressures.

stories.title: Eva Air green transport pact to cut Microsoft freight emissions by 15,000 tonnes
stories.summary: Eva Air and AIT Worldwide Logistics signed an MOU to use sustainable aviation fuel from Formosa Petrochemical to cut Microsoft cloud-related freight emissions by 15,000 tonnes.
